title: adapted BASIC Game of Life (55_Life): bounded 6-generation run of a declared 12x30 padded flat-window grid seeded by literal stores, centre-inclusive two-pass Conway semantics, nested single-character cellprint printer, every PUT single-item

notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 6 of 8 (Game of Life, BASIC).
SCOPE FALSIFICATION (hop 9, kept): upstream LIFE.bas NEVER TERMINATES - line 640
GOTO 210 loops forever and line 650 END is dead code, so a finite complete stream
is impossible without a declared bound.
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) THE PATTERN-INPUT PHASE IS DROPPED (declared): BASIC 100..150 read rows with
INPUT B$(C) and decode them with LEN/LEFT$/RIGHT$/MID$ and the DONE sentinel;
CHARACTER console GET is UNMEASURED and SUBSTR/LENGTH are measured refusals, so
the initial population is DECLARED instead: 18 literal stores a(k) = 1 on the
flat padded grid (indices 69,77,78,102,109,132,133,134,144,175,176,274,306,338,
348,349,380,381 = glider + beacon + block + blinker). The program still gets the
bare ^Z console input so the harness anchors identically; no GET is executed.
(2) GRID: the 24x70 board becomes a DECLARED 12x30 window held in ONE flat padded
array a(448) fixed bin(15), interior index n = x*32 + y + 1; the unwritten ring
absorbs all eight neighbour offsets -33..+33 without bounds tests (AGG.MULTIDIM
is a pinned refusal). A 70-cell row would print 139 raw bytes, crossing the
UNCHARACTERIZED proposed 79-column PLILIB wrap law - forbidden by the FS-01
boundary, hence the smaller window.
(3) BOUNDED RUN: do g = 0 to 5; prints SIX generations (0..5); recorded against
the non-terminating upstream.
(4) DYNAMIC BOUNDING BOX AND INVALID! DROPPED (declared, not silent): BASIC
215/262..268/299/635 track a moving print box and 301..307 clamp it, firing
INVALID! when the box cannot hold the pattern (Y1 < 3). The port scans the whole
declared window every generation; the shift in (5) keeps the pattern inside the
window for the whole bounded run, so the clamps are unnecessary here.
(5) PATTERN CORRECTIONS (measured by two independent models): the hop-10
"beacon" coordinates DIE OUT; the real period-2 beacon is (2,12),(2,13),(3,12),
(4,15),(5,14),(5,15), flickering 6 -> 8 -> 6. ALL FOUR patterns are SHIFTED 2
COLUMNS RIGHT (glider (2,4),(3,5),(4,3),(4,4),(4,5); block (10,27),(10,28),
(11,27),(11,28); blinker (8,17),(9,17),(10,17)) because the un-shifted glider
cell (4,1) sat on the interior edge y=1 and the window-margin invariant (plus
upstream's own Y1 < 3 clamp) falsified that placement. Declared initial
population 18 (NOT the hop-10 15); printed populations 18,20,18,20,18,20.
(6) NEIGHBOUR COUNT INCLUDES THE CENTRE (correction of the hop-11 model, kept
as written per PROTOCOL #2): BASIC 530/540 scan I=X-1 TO X+1, J=Y-1 TO Y+1 with
NO self-exclusion and 590 IF C<3 OR C>4 THEN A(X,Y)=2 is the Conway rule ONLY
because a live cell counts itself. The draft adds t2 = a(n); if t2 = 1 then s =
s + 1; to the eight-temp ladder; the eight neighbours count marks 1 AND 2 (2 =
marked-dying is still alive) but NOT 3 (marked-born), exactly as BASIC 550.
(7) TWO-PASS SINGLE-ARRAY SEMANTICS KEPT: evolution marks 2 = dying / 3 = born
and recounts cs (survivors + births); the NEXT print pass renders v = 1 for
states 1 and 3 and finalizes 2 -> 0, 3 -> 1 before the following evolution -
the upstream order (header printed BEFORE the marks are finalized).
(8) DEATH LADDER AS DEFAULT + RESTORE: inside the live guard the draft writes
a(n) = 2; then if s = 3 / s = 4 restore a(n) = 1 and count cs - this covers
EVERY s including s = 9 (centre + all eight neighbours, which an enumerated
ladder would miss) using only measured positive-literal and zero-literal scalar
compares (array members in conditions and OR-composed member tests are measured
refusals; equality-to-0 on a SCALAR is run-witnessed in AMAZ/HANG/WKDAY).
(9) DEAD CELLS RENDER '.' (declared cosmetic divergence): under the gate
normalization collapse-spaces-v1 a blank background collapses every grid row to
a run of stars with NO column information; '.' makes each row 30 positional
tokens while live cells stay '*', per the AMAZ-00 '.' precedent.
(10) PRINTER: every interior cell prints ONE character via the nested procedure
cellprint(q) owning its own character(1) varying (HANG-00 show law); every put
list is SINGLE-ITEM under the MEASURED leading-blank separator law; fixed
bin(15) items render right-justified in a NINE-column field (BIGA lane-B law +
FCPS1 [C352]) - the header line GENERATION/9d/POPULATION/9d is 41 raw bytes,
inside the proposed 79-column bound.
(11) PADDING AND BANNER (declared): the TAB(34)/TAB(15) banner offsets are
dropped (no counted PUT; EDIT-00 measures the counted refusal) leaving LIFE +
CREATIVE COMPUTING  MORRISTOWN, NEW JERSEY + three blanks; the dynamic blank-row
padding of BASIC 225/295 is FIXED to ONE blank line before every generation and
ONE bottom pad after the loop.
(12) EXPLICIT ZERO-INIT REQUIRED: do i = 1 to 448; a(i) = 0; end; - the initial
content of an un-initialized static DATA segment is UNMEASURED on lane B, zeros
are never assumed.
(13) FRAMING: the stream starts with LIFE on line 1 (first PUT is a PUT LIST, no
leading blank); the bottom pad closes line 89 and the exit CRLF [C352] yields ONE
trailing blank line - 91 normalized lines, 4722 raw bytes predicted.
(14) DERIVATION: expected.console is generated from reference.py:life00, a
statement-for-statement mirror of THIS pinned source, and was diffed BYTE-EQUAL
against the independent simulator build/fc01-scratch/life00_sim.py (91/91 lines
and the byte-identical 4722-B raw stream) BEFORE this JSON was written; the
simulator's grids additionally agree with an UNBOUNDED set-based Conway model on
all 6 printed generations, and both models carry the same independent invariants
(header cs == live count, window margin incl. the never-printed gen-6 state,
block 4 / glider 5 / blinker 3 / beacon 6-8, 30-token rows, stars == cs, the
91-line identity). Never captured (L3).
(15) CAPABILITIES were grep-verified twice by the generating script: each id
exists in spec/COVERAGE.tsv with dr_status=ACCEPTS and mine_status=SUPPORTED AND
its construct appears in LIFE-00.PLI. IO.GET_LIST and TRAN.GOTO_SAME_BLOCK are
NOT claimed (this program executes no GET and no GOTO - the loops are DO TO and
the two passes are sequential), and no BY-loop or ELSE appears.
(16) Lane-B RUN of the nested cellprint call INSIDE the doubly-nested DO and of
the 896-byte a(448) static grid is UNWITNESSED until this spec executes (both
shapes are COMPILE-witnessed: s10a rc=0, BIGA lane-B PASS with two 1681-element
arrays); a FAIL stays classified (my-gap / dr-refuses / unmeasured), never
laundered, and the expectation is NOT edited to chase a PASS.
